what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted 3-0 to continue the Bright Farms public hearing to November 23 at 6:35.
The board did not approve the water district's sign at 496 Mass Ave; it exceeds the size limit and needs zoning board relief first.
The board reviewed the stormwater bylaw presentation for Town Meeting, and the land use director will rework the slides to open with why the bylaw is changing.
The board voted 3-0 to accept changes to the Economic Development Committee charge.
The land use director will look into the Green Communities task force charge and call its chair about the planning board representative.

why_it_matters: The stormwater bylaw is headed to a special Town Meeting vote, and a simpler opening presentation is meant to make clear to voters what the change does and why.
The Bright Farms decision is still open, so the hearing on November 23 is the next point at which the board can act on that project.
